name: One More Pipeline Slot
description: Every future run starts the Burn Board one slot wider.
flavour: You have learned that the workflow is the product. Your therapist disagrees.

name: Keep the Linter
description: Aggressive Linter is yours from the first round of every run.
flavour: You kept the config file. It is the only thing you kept.

name: Keep the Whiteboard
description: Whiteboard Session is yours from the first round of every run.
flavour: The whiteboard survived the liquidation because nobody wanted it.

name: Keep the Distilled Weights
description: Distilled Model is yours from the first round of every run.
flavour: Legally these are not the same weights. Spiritually they are exactly the same weights.

name: The Rig Comes Home
description: Every future run starts with the next machine of a permanent rig already racked: first the custom desktop, then the GPU rack, then the compute cluster.
flavour: The liquidators never checked the storage unit. The storage unit hums.

name: Better Airflow, Permanently
description: Every future run starts with more cooling, so hot pipelines survive longer.
flavour: You now instinctively know where a room's hot spot is. This is not a useful skill elsewhere.

name: War Chest
description: Every future run starts with extra cash in the account.
flavour: The last exit cleared, after fees, after taxes, after the lawyer.

name: You Have Done This Before
description: Every future run starts with better baseline efficiency.
flavour: Muscle memory for a job that did not exist five years ago.

name: The Account Was Never Closed
description: Every future run begins with a cloud account already open, so the CLOUD key works from the first session instead of waiting on the Market.
flavour: Nobody at the provider has noticed. Nobody at the provider ever notices.

name: Capacity Already Provisioned
description: Every future run starts with cloud capacity running, and the account to go with it.
flavour: The invoice from the old account is still, technically, disputed.

name: A Client on Retainer
description: Every future run starts with a small passive income each round, bills or no bills.
flavour: They do not need anything this round either. They just like paying you.

name: The Bug Market
description: Undetected bugs shipped in production can now be sold instead of just risked.
flavour: Somewhere there is a spreadsheet of your defects, and somebody is trading it.

name: The Heat Recycler
description: Running hot now feeds back into throughput instead of only risking a fire.
flavour: Somebody plumbed the exhaust into the intake. It should not work. It works.

name: Failure as Research
description: A failed contract now teaches the rig something, nudging efficiency up instead of only costing reputation.
flavour: You are, technically, allowed to call this a postmortem.

name: The Circuit Breaker
description: Circuit Breaker is yours from the first round of every run: a module that behaves differently once heat crosses its line.
flavour: The first module in the shed that asks a question before it does anything.

name: A Second Workflow
description: Every future run starts with room for a second workflow, so two contracts can be worked through two different pipelines.
flavour: You never deleted the old workflow. You just stopped explaining why.

name: Old Silicon
description: Every future run burns tokens faster on the same hardware.
flavour: It still boots. That is the point.

name: Recurring Revenue
description: Retainers and standing orders pay more every round of every future run.
flavour: They forgot to cancel the standing order.

name: Rolodex
description: Permanent active perk capacity from people who owe you.
